name: Plated dish with steam
summary: A slow push-in over your dish as steam rises.
outcome: A slow push-in over your dish as steam rises and the light catches the sauces and textures.
photoGuidance: A close photo of one plated dish.
Shot at a slight angle, not straight down.
limitations: Text and logos in your photo may change in the video. Check the result before you post it.

inputs.label: The dish
inputs.help: For example, 'lamb kabsa on a white plate'.
inputs.example: Lamb kabsa on a white plate

options.label: A little
options.prompt: A little steam rises from the dish.

inputs.label: Details to keep as they are
inputs.help: Optional. For example, the colour of your cups or the shape of a sign.

inputs.label: Anything to leave out
inputs.help: Optional. For example, no smoke or no people.

prompt.preserve: Keep everything in the photo recognisable: the same objects, shapes, colours and proportions. Keep any printed text, labels and logos as they are.
prompt.avoid: Do not add people, hands, text, captions, logos or new objects. No sudden cuts, no camera shake, no warping or melting of surfaces.
prompt.subject: The photo shows {subject}.
prompt.composition: The plate stays centred and whole in the frame.
prompt.environment: The table and background stay as in the photo.
prompt.camera: The camera pushes in slowly towards the dish.
prompt.lighting: Warm light that catches the sauces and textures.
prompt.preserveExtra: The food stays exactly as plated.
